info.name: WLMS Phase 2 API Tests
info.description: 22 solicitudes automatizadas con aserciones de estado, esquema JSON y contenido. Incluye un flujo de negocio encadenado: login -> usuario -> ítem -> crear proveedor -> crear orden de compra -> agregar línea -> verificar detalle -> cancelar -> verificar estado -> rechazar segunda cancelación. La orden de prueba termina cancelada para no alterar inventario.

exec: pm.test('Item schema is valid when present', () => { if (body.length) { pm.expect(body[0]).to.include.keys('item_id','item_name','reorder_level','uom_symbol','is_active'); } });
pm.test('At least one item exists for the purchasing flow', () => pm.expect(body.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test('Suppliers content matches authorization', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); allowed ? pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array') : pm.expect(body).to.have.property('detail'); });

pm.test('Response matches JSON schema', () => { if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["supplier_id", "supplier_name", "email", "phone", "address", "is_active"], "properties": {"supplier_id": {"type": "integer"}, "supplier_name": {"type": "string"}, "email": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "phone": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "address": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "is_active": {"type": "boolean"}}}}); } else { pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type": "object", "required": ["detail"], "properties": {"detail": {}}}); } });
